Commands:
	WhitelistPlayer

	validateallbuildings

	UnWhitelistPlayer
		Usage: unwhitelistplayer <userid|platformid>
	UnbanPlayer

	sql
		Usage: sql <query>.
	Shutdown
		Usage: shutdown
	SetServerSetting
		Usage: SetServerSetting <Setting Name> <Setting Value>
	restart
		Usage: restart
	netprofile
		Usage: netprofile (enable|disable)
	memreportsilentevent
		Usage: memreportsilentevent (key)

		Usage: memreport

		Usage: listplayers
	listbans
		Usage: listbans
	KickPlayer
		Usage: kickplayer (index|name|userid|platformid|player) <identification> <message>

		Usage: help "Optional command name filter". lists all available rcon commands.

		Usage: exec (args)
	dumpticks

		Usage: con <id> <command> <args>. Where <id> is a valid online player ID or name#number, and <command> being a regular console command

		Usage: buildingdestroy <building ids>

	broadcast
		Usage: broadcast <message>

		Usage: banplayer (index|name|userid|platformid|player) <identification> <message>
